div.head: Northu 7
div.ab: Gif preost scildig sy ⁊ he ofer arcediacones gebod mæssige, gilde XII ór.
Gif preost scildig sy and he ofer arcediacones gebod mæssige, gilde XII or.
Wenn ein Priester schuldig [befunden] ist und er [nachher] gegen das Gebot des Archidiakons Messe liest, zahle er 12 Ör.
If a priest is [found] guilty and he [afterwards] says mass against the archdeacon's command, let him pay 12 ores.
If a priest commits an offence and he celebrates mass in spite of the archdeacon's prohibition, he is to pay 12 ores.
If a priest is guilty of wrongdoing and he holds Mass in spite of the archdeacon’s command, he is to pay twelve oras.

note.seg: Derselbe Fall wie 3, nur hat das Messelesen hier der Archidiakon verboten
The same case as 3, except that here it is the archdeacon who has forbidden the saying of mass
